_comment: Experiment 2: USR -> English sentence. Two conditions per model: _raw (USR only) and _guide (USR + usr_guidelines.md). Keys are read from ../exp1/keys.json.
prompt_system: You generate English sentences from semantic representations. You express exactly the meaning in the representation: you do not add, remove, replace or explain any information.
prompt_user:
Below is a USR (Universal Semantic Representation) of one sentence. Write the ONE English sentence it represents.
Rules: express every concept and relation; do not add information that is not in the USR; do not drop any concept; keep names (words without a sense number) as names written in Roman letters, do not translate or replace them; keep numbers, negation, tense and voice; no notes, no markdown, no alternatives.
Output ONLY the English sentence.

USR:
{usr}

Rules: express every concept and relation and the tense, aspect, modality, voice, negation and sentence type given; do not add information that is not in the USR; do not drop any concept; keep names (words without a sense number) as names written in Roman letters, do not translate or replace them; keep numbers; no notes, no markdown, no alternatives.
Output ONLY the English sentence.
